description: This Java source file defines theObbMountActivity class, an Android activity that manages OBB file mounting and unmounting. The class provides UI buttons for user interaction, displays status updates, and handles OBB state changes using StorageManager and OnObbStateChangeListener.

classes.name: ObbMountActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for managing OBB files; handles mounting, unmounting, and displaying status information.

classes.name: ObbState
classes.description: Inner static class used to retain OBB-related state across configuration changes, encapsulating StorageManager, status, and path information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and prepares OBB path and StorageManager instance.

methods.name: onRetainNonConfigurationInstance
methods.description: Retains the ObbState instance across configuration changes to preserve OBB state.
